India Panel Calls for NTA Regulation

A parliamentary panel in India has recommended granting a statutory status to the National Testing Agency (NTA), which oversees national-level entrance exams. The move aims to address concerns over the fairness of these exams, particularly for marginalized students. This development is significant as it highlights the need for regulatory oversight in the education sector.
